descriptionModule.briefSummary: Evaluating the rate of pathologic complete remission in patients with squamous esophageal cancer treated perioperatively with tislelizumab in combination with chemotherapy

interventions.name: Tislelizumab
interventions.description: Tislelizumab, 200mg, intravenously over 30 - 60 minutes, day 1 of every 3 weeks
